outlook.observed_trends.expert: SAMPLE TEXT, NOT A FORECAST. Floor stations have cooled about 2 C each night since Tuesday while the benches warmed, so the inversion is strengthening. Ozone at the floor sites has risen 5 to 8 ppb per day and peaked near 62 ppb on Wednesday afternoon. Winds stay below 2 m/s. Aircraft descents into Vernal show the inversion top near 1,950 m.
